projectDescription: A full-stack web application built with FastAPI and Jinja2 that enables CNEL EP staff to query, visualize, and export historical electrical consumption data for customers.
keyFeatures: Customer information lookup by numeric client code (datos personales, medidor, deuda SAP)
Historical account statement with credit/debit notes and payment agreements (estado de cuenta)
Historical energy consumption charts filtered by year (consumo activo y reactivo en kWh)
Historical meter readings with type and observation descriptions (lecturas)
Excel export of all client data with formatted worksheets via openpyxl + pandas
JWT-based authentication stored in HttpOnly cookies with role-based access control
Dual database setup: SQL Server (CNEL cloud data) + PostgreSQL (local users/roles)
Admin panel for user CRUD with role assignment (Admin-only)
publicApiSurface: POST /auth/login — OAuth2 password grant, returns JWT + sets HttpOnly cookie
GET /api/clientes/{codigo_cliente} — returns ClienteCompletoResponse (datos_personales, creditos_debitos, convenios, estado_cuenta, consumos, lecturas)
GET /api/export/excel/{codigo_cliente} — streams XLSX file with multiple formatted sheets
PUT /admin/api/usuarios/{id}/estado — toggle user active status (admin only)
GET /config — admin configuration panel (admin role required)
